title: Improved Friedgut junta size bound
statement: For a Boolean function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and real parameters $\epsilon$ and $\eta$, the improved Friedgut junta size bound for linear threshold functions is $1$ plus the improved Friedgut junta-size term for $f$, $\epsilon$, and $\eta$, evaluated at the improved Friedgut degree $\lceil16/\epsilon^2\rceil$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The payload omits the definition of the improved Friedgut junta-size term.
